# AI Slop Meter

> Open-source MCP server, CLI and bookmarklet that scores how much "AI slop" a website, a local app or a web project has (0-100), shows the evidence down to file and line, and gives step-by-step fixes your own AI (Claude, Cursor, Gemini CLI) can carry out. It also gives an AI search readiness score. Rule-based, runs on your computer, free, MIT license.

- Install for Claude Code: `claude mcp add --scope user aislopmeter -- npx -y aislopmeter mcp`
- Try without installing: `npx -y aislopmeter https://your-site.com --open`
- English and Turkish reports.
